title: iris cengialti var. illyrica
intro: Iris cengialti var. illyrica, commonly known as Dalmatian iris, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Iris genus. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms associated with respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Iris cengialti var. illyrica include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides. These constituents are believed to contribute to its health benefits, including antioxidant and antimicrobial effects.
